title: MASTERS ATTP 2026 final – a clash of Moldova’s table tennis titans
excerpt: The final of the elite MASTERS ATTP 2026 tournament brought together the country’s best 18 players, in the competition’s third consecutive edition.
body_html:
The arena witnessed one of the most intense and spectacular moments of the season: the final of MASTERS ATTP 2026, the elite competition that for the third year running brings together the TOP 18 strongest table tennis players in the Republic of Moldova.

The event was held under the auspices of the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players (ATTP), with the support of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova, and is regarded as one of the four major events of the season — competitions that decide the make-up of the national squad for the following year.

Throughout the tournament the country’s best players served up matches of a high technical level, but the highlight was the grand final, which pitted two of the current leaders of Moldovan table tennis against each other: Denis ȚERNA and Veniamin DUBROVIN, both members of the Republic of Moldova national team that has qualified for the World Table Tennis Championships London 2026.

The final was extremely close and tense, with spectacular rallies and swings in momentum right up to the last set. In a high-intensity duel decided on the finest of margins, Veniamin DUBROVIN won 3:2, showing once again the excellent form he is in.

The win extends the player’s impressive run: the month before, he also won the “Federation Cup 2026”, strengthening his place among the leaders of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova.

Victory at MASTERS ATTP 2026 secures Veniamin DUBROVIN a place in the Republic of Moldova squad for the 2027 season — but the sporting rivalries are far from over.

In just a week, in the same arena, the public will see a new chapter in the top-level battles of Moldovan table tennis. The champions and runners-up of recent years — Vladislav Ursu and Andrei Puțuntică — will enter the competition to defend their titles, promising another show of the highest level.

MASTERS ATTP thus continues to confirm its role as the ultimate stage for performance in Moldovan table tennis, where the best of the best compete for glory, trophies and a place in the national team.
